experiment: Round 5: real-window trainability, same-dimensional continuous representation, and auxiliary target diagnostics
scope: Complete bounded diagnostic experiment and chronological raw-only validation. No new 2024-2026 forecasts or repeated development-window scoring in this round. Previously inspected historical validation is exploratory, not a virgin confirmation set.
data: Reuse round-4 frozen 125-bar CSI300 inputs, daily matured execution labels, original OHLCV and model sources. Fixed 25 x 5 patches in all round-5 arms isolate representation, initialization and loss. No adaptive segmentation changes.
continuous: Official frozen Kronos tokenizer embed -> encoder -> quant_embed -> torch.nn.functional.normalize(p=2,dim=-1), immediately before BSQuantizer sign operation. Twenty dimensions and per-bar unit norm as for bipolar bits; no per-representation fitted scaling or PCA. Encode each observed 125-bar window independently using exact round-4 normalized float32 cached input.
provenance: Reuse round-4 official Crossformer revision c10c8eadb153d1dd9798250967747ca3ebb81383 and round-3 Kronos revision 67b630e67f6a18c9e9be918d9b4337c960db1e9a / tokenizer checkpoint 0e0117387f39004a9016484a186a908917e22426. Freeze hashes of old evidence and dependencies; do not modify them.
pretraining_boundary: Pretrained bits/continuous may be used on pre-2018 samples ONLY for explicitly in-sample capacity diagnostics. They are forbidden in 2018-2020 chronological validation, candidate selection or predictive claims because the paper states pretraining through June 2024.

targets.auxiliary: Five following bars x OHLCV. Each price target is log(future price/current observed close); volume target is log1p(future volume) minus mean log1p(volume) of the last 20 observed bars. Each of 25 auxiliary coordinates is standardized with mature training labels only.
targets.eligibility: All five future OHLCV bars must be finite, positive OHLC, nonnegative volume and internally valid. Joint completed date is max(original return completed date, date at anchor+5). All compared arms use exactly these shared eligible/mature observations, even return-only arms.
targets.limitation: OHLCV auxiliary loss is an explicitly defined local objective, not a reproduction of missing article OHLCAV training details; no real amount is available.

architecture: Reuse round-4 masked Crossformer, geometry and scalar return head. Add the same per-decoder-coordinate linear D->5 auxiliary projection in every variant. Restore RNG state after initializing added projection so shared backbone/return initialization and subsequent dropout streams match; nonzero initialization uses an isolated seed+101 RNG fork. Return-only loss excludes auxiliary computation. Joint loss is standardized return MSE + 0.1 * standardized 25-coordinate auxiliary MSE. Do not detach the auxiliary branch.

capacity.selection: 32 equally spaced eligible observations with joint_completed <= cutoff, selected by rounded linspace indices without looking at target magnitude/sign.
capacity.runs: 3 representations x 3 Crossformer variants x 3 seeds = 27 real-label capacity fits. Additionally, flattened-input MLP(64 GELU -> scalar) for all 3 representations x real/permuted-return labels x 3 seeds = 18 positive capacity controls. One fixed label permutation seed 20260914 is used across representations and training seeds.
capacity.qualification: Prespecified diagnostic PASS if final standardized real/shuffled return MSE <= 0.1 and return correlation >= 0.9. Always report final and minimum errors and all seeds. Fitting shuffled labels establishes memorization capacity only, not prediction skill. No early stopping or selected best seed.
capacity.metrics: Initial and final backbone/return-head gradient norms; final return and auxiliary MSE; correlation; prediction std; evaluate original input and a cyclic reassignment of complete sample windows with geometry/mask intact. Save step 0,1,2,5,10,25,50,100,200,400 curves, final predictions and checkpoints.

validation.selection_rows: Friday signals in 2018-2020 whose joint labels are completed by 2020-12-31. All daily training rows have joint_completed <= each cutoff; no random split.
validation.runs: All 3 variants x 3 annual folds x 3 seeds = 27 fits; save checkpoints at each of the 4 epoch candidates.
validation.selection: After every fit is complete, compute three-seed mean predictions, select variant/epoch by minimum pooled RMSE; ties prefer fewer epochs then protocol variant order. No health-result-dependent pruning, new hyperparameters or budget extension. Report every candidate, per-year and per-seed errors, raw training-mean and zero-return baselines.
validation.primary_comparisons: At matched epochs 5 and 20: return_nonzero vs return_zero, joint_ohlcv vs return_zero. Four pooled-MSE comparisons, eight-observation circular block bootstrap, 10000 replicates, seed 20260910, Holm across four. Exploratory because historical validation and repeated research; selected winner is not independent out-of-sample evidence.
validation.metrics: RMSE, sign accuracy, forecast std, balanced accuracy, error vs training mean, fixed-final-model train MSE, held-out return MSE before/after cyclic within-fold input reassignment. Input reassignment is diagnostic only and must not drive selection.

execution: Use existing isolated research_v4/.venv_gpu Python 3.13 and CUDA float32, deterministic algorithms, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8, TF32 off, four CPU threads. No new packages or changes to shared runtimes.
verification: Check prequant signs against official bits, per-bar unit norm, past-window causality, source/cache hashes, shared eligible dates and completed labels, gradient connectivity, every saved checkpoint hash and deterministic prediction replay. Preserve previous four rounds.
